LanguageData.TtpAgeOfAIPawn: The biological age of the AI pawn
LanguageData.TtpAgeOfPlayerPawn: The biological age of the player pawn
LanguageData.TtpGenderOfAIPawn: The gender of the AI pawn (male/female)
LanguageData.TtpGenderOfPlayerPawn: The gender of the player pawn (male/female)
LanguageData.TtpFullNameOfPlayerPawn: The name of the player controlled pawn
LanguageData.TtpFullNameOfAIPawn: The name of the ai controlled pawn
LanguageData.TtpShortNameOfAIPawn: The nickname of the ai controlled pawn
LanguageData.TtpShortNameOfPlayerPawn: The nickname of the player controlled pawn
LanguageData.TtpTraitsOfAIPawn: The traits of the AI pawn
LanguageData.TtpTraitsOfPlayerPawn: The traits of the player pawn
LanguageData.TtpAiRelationToPlayerPawn: The AI pawn's relation to the player pawn. Will say something like '{pawn1} is the child of {pawn2}'
LanguageData.TtpPlayerRelationToAiPawn: The player pawn's relation to the AI pawn Will say something like '{pawn1} is the child of {pawn2}'
LanguageData.TtpAiCurrentActivity: Activity the AI pawn is currently doing.
LanguageData.TtpPlayerCurrentActivity: Activity the player pawn is currently doing
LanguageData.TtpAiPawnTrader: Says directly if the pawn is a trader. If not a trader, then this will be blank.
LanguageData.TtpPlayerPawnTrader: Says if the player pawn is a trader. If not a trader, then this will be blank.
LanguageData.TtpAiMood: Says a word that describes the ai recipient's mood
LanguageData.TtpPlayerMood: Says a word that describes the player pawn's mood
LanguageData.TtpAiNeeds: Lists the ai recipient's needs that need attending. Says 'none' if no needs need attending
LanguageData.TtpPlayerNeeds: Lists the player pawn's needs that need attending. Says 'none' if no needs need attending
LanguageData.TtpAiIsSlave: Says if the ai recipient is a slave. If they are not a slave, this will be blank.
LanguageData.TtpPlayerIsSlave: Says if the player pawn is a slave. If they are not a slave, this will be blank.
LanguageData.TtpRecentMemoriesOfAIPawn: Gives a list of all the memories of the ai pawn. If there are no memories, will say 'None'
LanguageData.TtpRecentMemoriesOfPlayerPawn: Gives a list of all the memories of the player pawn. If there are no memories, will say 'None'
LanguageData.TtpHealthConditionsOfAIPawn: Lists the health conditions affecting the ai pawn. If there are none, this will say 'none'.
LanguageData.TtpHealthConditionsOfPlayerPawn: Lists the health conditions affecting the player pawn. If there are none, this will say 'none'.
LanguageData.TtpBackstoryOfAIPawn: Gives the descriptions of the ai pawn's childhood and adulthood.
LanguageData.TtpBackstoryOfPlayerPawn: Gives the descriptions of the player pawn's childhood and adulthood.
LanguageData.TtpXenotypeOfAIPawn: Gives the xenotype name or 'human' for baseliners.
LanguageData.TtpXenotypeOfPlayerPawn: Gives the xenotype name or 'human' for baseliners.
LanguageData.TtpMemoriesWithInitiatorOfAIPawn: Gives a list of the most recent and impactful memories created by Talk to Pawns
LanguageData.TtpMemoriesWithRecipientOfPlayerPawn: Gives a list of the most recent and impactful memories created by Talk to Pawns
LanguageData.TtpIdeoDescriptionOfAIPawn: Gives the 'narrative' part of the AI pawn's ideology
LanguageData.TtpIdeoDescriptionOfPlayerPawn: Gives the 'narrative' part of player pawn's ideology
LanguageData.TtpIdeoMemesOfAIPawn: Gives the description of the memes that make up the AI pawn's ideology
LanguageData.TtpIdeoMemesOfPlayerPawn: Gives the description of the memes that make up the player pawn's ideology
LanguageData.TtpIdeoCertaintyOfAIPawn: Gives the certainty of the AI pawn's ideology beliefs as a percentage
LanguageData.TtpIdeoCertaintyOfPlayerPawn: Gives the certainty of the player pawn's ideology beliefs as a percentage
